scope: Admit an unchanged same-revision AC1027 or AC1032 direct-NOD WIPEOUTVARIABLES display-frame 1 with the two observed role-4 references, missing XDictionary, zero data-storage bit and exact 10-bit BS value. Existing frame-0, AC1024 and nested profile paths retain their separate checks. This is selected-record graph evidence, not physical whole-document or native rendering qualification.

source.provenance: A scratch R2010 DXF with one WIPEOUT and ACAD_WIPEOUT_VARS.frame=1 was authored from scratch using ezdxf 1.4.5 (tools/author_wipeout_ac1024_frame1.py). ODA File Converter 27.1.0 converted it separately to AC1027 and AC1032 DWG and back to matching-revision DXF; no .err occurred. No binary drawing fixture was added. Regeneration can produce different hashes.
source.independent: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 independently decodes type 516 object 0x30 with frame 1, NOD 0xA owner role 4, one reactor role 4 to 0xA, missing XDictionary, data-storage flag 0 and 51 data bits in each DWG. Both CRC traces report 0x197E matching the computed CRC. ezdxf independently reads frame 1 from both ODA-returned DXFs.
source.source_frame: For each hash-bound source, in-tree adapter capture plus a separate bit walk observes an 11-byte frame with 37 handle-stream bits: type [0,10), self [10,26), empty EED [26,28), reactor count [28,38), XDictionary-missing [38,39), zero data-storage bit [39,40), frame BS [40,50)=0x101, absent string marker [50,51), owner role-4 [51,67), reactor role-4 [67,83), five zero pad bits [83,88). The physical bytes/roles are identical for these two object frames; the enclosing DWG formats remain separately bound and no version-wide equivalence is inferred. In-tree capture is not an independent DWG page decoder.
source.whole_source: The scratch candidate CLI observed 109/109 source frames on AC1027 and 105/105 on AC1032, but both strict full-source exports refused at the existing two HEADER integrity observations. Each preserved the preexisting destination. Generated adapter readback does not establish physical whole-file conversion, source-NOD remapping or WIPEOUT preview/rendering.

implementation: Add AC1027 and AC1032 to the direct-NOD frame-1 graph and preflight gates, reusing the existing same-version source/class/owner/uniqueness checks. Their raw observer requires the versioned zero data-storage bit and the source-observed 10-bit BS frame-1 form, and compares it to the typed callback. Frame-1 values on AC1018 remain refused; no alternate BS form or additional owner/reactor pattern is admitted.

validation.result: 9/9 pass, plus the existing AC1027 nested transport selector 1/1. Each new generated version exports strict RequireComplete ASCII and Binary with resolved owners and verifies typed NOD/owner/reactor/root/handle/frame readback. Negative controls cover typed/source mismatch, changed wire value, noncanonical 18-bit BS, storage bit/metadata, owner/reactor wire roles, wrong version, duplicate/aliased/missing roots, cross-version and unsupported display modes, with preserved destination and same-adapter retry. The alternative BS test constructs value 1 in the legal longer form and independently decodes it and the unchanged marker/handle tail before requiring refusal.
validation.source_audit: Compile tools/probe_wipeout_ac1027_1032_frame1_source.cpp against the candidate adapter object and libdxfrw.a; invoke tools/audit_wipeout_ac1027_1032_frame1_source.py AC1027|AC1032 <witness.dwg> <probe>. The wrapper checks each exact source SHA before and after capture.
validation.integrated_focused: Built the adapter test on the integrated candidate and ran the nine frame, direct-NOD and nested-refusal selectors: 9/9 passed.

remaining: Physical whole-document conversion and native rendering/preview, additional BS encodings, other revisions, nested owner shapes and broader dependencies remain open.
